title: WabbleSpec Drawer
description: Evidence drawer. Written by Memory. Read by MemorySearch. One JSON file per topic-cluster.

id.description: Unique drawer ID. Format: {topic-slug}-{YYYYMMDD}. Max 60 chars.

wing.description: Wing name. Matches directory under memory/wings/.

room.description: Room name. Matches directory under wing/rooms/.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When staleness was last confirmed FRESH via re-verification.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry. null = no hard expiry, subject to activity-decay only.

source.description: Path, URL, or reference string for evidence origin.

source_module.description: Module ID that wrote this drawer.

confidence.description: Trust score. 1.0 = fully verified. Below 0.7 must be flagged on use.

evidence.description: Evidence content. Plain text or structured prose.

superseded_by.description: Drawer ID that supersedes this. Required when staleness_state = SUPERSEDED.

contradicts.description: Drawer ID this evidence contradicts. Flagged by Provenance.

provenance.description: Append-only event log for this drawer. Never remove entries.
